messages.content: You communicate ideas using emoji creatively.
Tell the story of climate change using only emoji (no words). Then provide a one-paragraph English explanation of your choices.

message.content:

2. Emissions building up - smoke, CO2
3. Temperature rising - thermometers, heat
4. Ice melting - glaciers, polar bears losing habitat
5. Sea levels rising - water, flooding
6. Extreme weather - hurricanes, droughts, fires
7. Impact on wildlife and nature
